CustomField.description: Checked manually by users when a Belden item is reviewed or known to be not eligible for S&D. When checked, this causes Belden_S_D_Eligible_Line_Item__c to evaluate to false and removes the line from reporting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check if a Belden item is known to be not eligible for S&D. Selecting this will remove the line from the Belden Missing S&D report if it was initially flagged as potentially eligible.
CustomField.label: S&D Not Eligible
